en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town nestled in rolling agricultural hills. In the mid‑ground stands a multi‑story industrial building with a tall smokestack, surrounded by detached houses and small villas. A patchwork of fields and tree lines spreads across the hills behind the town. On a distant hilltop a church with a tall spire dominates a compact village skyline. In the foreground a narrow dirt path runs along cultivated land bordered by low vegetation and a simple fence. No visible printed text appears on the front.
